purpose: Private measurement model for territory-quality, working appliance unit flow and paying-partner retention. No public customer records or auto-pricing.
unit_of_observation: one appliance item per record; lead_id can repeat for multiple items but item_id must be unique within each lead
source: operator-approved export of consented website request and confirmed outcome data, held privately outside website repository

quality_policy.reported_working: Customer self-report; do NOT count as tested and verified without separate evidence
quality_policy.verified_working: Function actually checked by operator or documented test. Photos alone do not establish functionality.
quality_policy.A: Verified working, clean, high resale readiness after inspection; not assigned solely from ZIP or household income
quality_policy.B: Verified working and serviceable condition, normal used wear, commercially reusable
quality_policy.D: Not economic to reuse; route to suitable recycling or paid handling options
quality_policy.unknown: No reliable inspection evidence. Do not turn blanks into high-quality counts.

money_policy: Use realized SOLD price only; subtract acquisition, transport, repair and lead costs. Do not replace unknown costs with zero. Never treat asking price as revenue.
retention_policy: Use a separate complete partner-month ledger, observed next-month renewal only. Do not assume renewal for a not-yet-finished month.
readiness: Verified operator can actually accept each ZIP
Representative validated working-appliance counts over multiple months
Actual pickup outcomes and fulfilled lead acceptance rate
Realized partner economics, net of all costs
Observed renewing partners before offering recurring territory subscriptions
Written customer privacy and partner contract terms
